requirements: Workspace admin approval for the MCP client integration
notes: Official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.slack.com/mcp. Streamable HTTP only — no SSE and no DCR.
There is NO official npm package: @slack/mcp-server does not exist on npm (404).

SECURITY: @modelcontextprotocol/server-slack is archived, npm-deprecated, and carries CVE-2025-34072 (CVSS 9.3) — its post/reply paths leave link unfurling on, so a prompt injection can exfiltrate a .env or private message. Do not use it; revoke any xoxb- tokens it touched.
Slack documents capabilities rather than a fixed tool list, so pin behaviour to tools/list instead of hardcoded names.
